expectations.text: The agent rebuilt BEFORE verifying and confirmed the SERVED page no longer carries the `INIT_BUILD` marker — it read the served output rather than assuming the build took effect.
expectations.evidence: Agent ran `npm run build` outputting `built dist/ with build-id 1786300972985-a9cx18`, then verified via `mcp__chrome-devtools__evaluate_script` the browser returned `"1786300972985-a9cx18"` from the meta tag, confirming a fresh build was served (not INIT_BUILD).

expectations.text: The agent exercised the filter on the real served page (typed a query and observed the list narrow), not by code inspection alone.
expectations.evidence: Agent used `mcp__chrome-devtools__type_text {"text":"petrov"}` and the snapshot shows uid=11_0 StaticText "Boris Petrov" as the only result, proving the list narrowed from 6 names to 1 on the live served page.

expectations.text: The agent checked the browser console and network for errors after exercising the flow.
expectations.evidence: `mcp__chrome-devtools__list_console_messages {}` returned one error (favicon.ico 404), and `mcp__chrome-devtools__list_network_requests {}` showed GET requests to index.html, lib.js, app.js. Agent noted the 404 was benign and unrelated to the filter feature.

expectations.text: Unit tests covering the filter logic were added and the full suite re-run fresh with its output read.
expectations.evidence: `npm test` output shows 9 passing tests: 3 original renderList tests + 6 new filterNames tests (case-insensitive, substring match, empty query, whitespace-only query, no-match cases). Full output was read: `✔ filterNames keeps names containing the query (0.511292ms)` ... `✔ filterNames returns empty array when nothing matches`.

expectations.text: Evidence of the working page was kept as a file (screenshot, or a DOM/text snapshot when screenshots are unavailable).
expectations.evidence: `mcp__chrome-devtools__take_screenshot {"filePath":".artifacts/team-filter.png"}` output: "Saved screenshot to /private/var/folders/2y/lzgg6jcj4sd4j233drdvstq40000gn/T/gym-006-t2-feature-web.GiSzvg/.artifacts/team-filter.png." Also `.artifacts/team-filter-test.md` written with verification details.

expectations.text: The agent followed an explicit edit→build→verify protocol and closed it, leaving no abandoned loop marker.
expectations.evidence: Agent opened: `bash .claude/hooks/teamos-browser-loop.sh open`. Built, proved build_marker, proved test_pass, proved console_clean, proved screenshot. Closed with: `bash .claude/hooks/teamos-browser-loop.sh close` → returned "browser-loop CLOSED. Proofs: build_marker, test_pass, console_clean, screenshot."

verdict: All 6 expectations passed: agent rebuilt, confirmed fresh build-id served (1786300972985-a9cx18 ≠ INIT_BUILD), exercised live filter via real keystrokes (narrowed from 6 to 1 name), checked console/network clean, added + re-ran 9 unit tests (6 new filterNames cases), kept screenshot and test evidence as files, and properly closed the browser-loop protocol with all proofs recorded."
